accessibility.fullDescription: The janitor cart directly in front of the extinguisher cabinet represents obstructed access. The folded chairs are an authored decoy and are safe as depicted because they are stable inside a rack and outside the passage. Exact source applicability and correction language require content-editor approval before scored use.
